yaml_document:
blueprint_id: blp_7xfkarv1ev9z2azhv1e74wfzev
name: Task Verification
description: >
  Verify that a task was completed correctly against a reference procedure

# Expose most configurable knobs currently implemented with their defaults. We may
# or may not want to expose them all in the final blueprint.
values:
  # Maximum number of tokens the model may generate in the response. `1..=128000`.
  # Shares the fusion node's context window with the prompt.
  max_new_tokens: 8192

  # --- VideoReaderNode ---
  # Number of frames to uniformly sample across the video. `<= 0` keeps every
  # frame. `-1` is the default the VideoReader node enforces (kept non-default here).
  max_frames: 16
  # If set, each frame is resized to a `size x size` square (bilinear). `null`
  # keeps the source resolution, the default the VideoReader node enforces (kept
  # non-default here).
  size: 224
  # Frames per emitted data message. Must be `>= 1`. Default: 64.
  reader_batch_size: 64

  # --- VideoPreprocessorNode (all at their defaults) ---
  # Target number of frames per preprocessor push. Default: 64.
  preprocessor_batch_size: 64
  # Max ms to wait for more frames before pushing a partial batch (`0` disables). Default: 200.
  preprocessor_batching_delay_ms: 200
  # Spatial patch size in pixels (Qwen3-VL: 16). Default: 16.
  preprocessor_patch_size: 16
  # Spatial merge factor (Qwen3-VL: 2). Default: 2.
  preprocessor_merge_size: 2
  # Frames grouped along the temporal axis per token row (Qwen3-VL: 2). Default: 2.
  preprocessor_temporal_patch_size: 2
  # Per-channel mean subtracted after rescaling. Default: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5].
  preprocessor_image_mean: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]
  # Per-channel std divided after mean subtraction. Default: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5].
  preprocessor_image_std: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]
  # Rescale factor applied to raw u8 pixels before normalize (1/255). Default: 0.00392156862745098.
  preprocessor_rescale_factor: 0.00392156862745098
  # Lower bound on the spatiotemporal token volume. Default: 4096.
  preprocessor_min_pixels: 4096
  # Upper bound on the spatiotemporal token volume. Default: 25165824.
  preprocessor_max_pixels: 25165824

  # --- TaskVerificationResultsParserNode ---
  # Attach template-conformance stats under `result_parser_stats`. Default: false.
  parser_compute_stats: false
  # Emit the `frame_start`/`frame_end` columns. Default: true.
  parser_output_frame_indices: true

# Logical model names used by the model-bearing nodes. Deployments map these
# resolved names to checkpoint directories through `artifacts` or runtime config.
models:
  fusion: "newton-fusion:1.0"
  whisper: "whisper:large-v3"

connectors:
  source:
    key: MultiModalSource

  sink:
    key: RecordsSink
    config:
      format: json/per-request

nodes:
  # Accumulates the SOP step lines into a single prepared-instruction string.
  # (PrepareSOPNode has no configurable knobs.)
  prepare:
    key: PrepareSOPNode

  splitter:
    key: SplitterNode

  # Decodes the referenced video into RGB frames. Requires the `opencv` feature.
  video_reader:
    key: VideoReaderNode
    config:
      max_frames: ${values.max_frames}
      size: ${values.size}
      batch_size: ${values.reader_batch_size}

  video_preprocessor:
    key: VideoPreprocessorNode
    config:
      batch_size: ${values.preprocessor_batch_size}
      batching_delay_ms: ${values.preprocessor_batching_delay_ms}
      patch_size: ${values.preprocessor_patch_size}
      merge_size: ${values.preprocessor_merge_size}
      temporal_patch_size: ${values.preprocessor_temporal_patch_size}
      image_mean: ${values.preprocessor_image_mean}
      image_std: ${values.preprocessor_image_std}
      rescale_factor: ${values.preprocessor_rescale_factor}
      min_pixels: ${values.preprocessor_min_pixels}
      max_pixels: ${values.preprocessor_max_pixels}

  # Decodes the referenced video's audio track into a raw waveform. Requires the
  # `ffmpeg` feature.
  audio_reader:
    key: AudioReaderNode

  whisper:
    key: WhisperModelNode
    config:
      model: ${models.whisper}

  prompt:
    key: TaskVerificationPromptGeneratorNode

  fusion:
    key: NewtonFusionModelNode
    config:
      model: ${models.fusion}
      max_new_tokens: ${values.max_new_tokens}

  parser:
    key: TaskVerificationResultsParserNode
    config:
      compute_stats: ${values.parser_compute_stats}
      output_frame_indices: ${values.parser_output_frame_indices}

graph:
  edges:
    # The SOP text is turned into an instruction, then written by the text sink.
    - { from: source.text, to: prepare.in }
    # The video "url" is sent in parallel for frame extraction and audio transcription.
    - { from: source.video, to: splitter.in }
    - { from: splitter.left, to: video_reader.in }
    - { from: splitter.right, to: audio_reader.in }

    # Output of the frame extraction is pre-processed.
    - { from: video_reader.out, to: video_preprocessor.in }
    # Output of the audio extraction is transcribed.
    - { from: audio_reader.out, to: whisper.in }

    # All "prepared inputs" are gathered into the prompt generation
    - { from: prepare.out, to: prompt.instruction }
    - { from: video_preprocessor.out, to: prompt.video }
    - { from: whisper.out, to: prompt.audio }

    # The prompt is sent to the fusion mode, the result parsed, and sent to the sink
    - { from: prompt.out, to: fusion.in }
    - { from: fusion.out, to: parser.in }
    - { from: parser.out, to: sink.in }

artifacts:
  "newton-fusion:1.0": "s3://atai-marketplace-model-depot/newton/f1_0_35b_a3b_fp8_base_040625b4d0750b"
